cards.title: Block classification scheme (who or what produces each block)
cards.block: Builder > Guidance > Block classification (applies to every ontology node)
cards.default: (default + heuristic) Five classes. Rule: if a formula or sourced default gives an acceptable value, G; if an existing asset is the truth, E; if quality depends on a human creator, D; if a named tool gets an engineer there with a caveat, T; if only the business knows, I. Map the classes onto gstack's decision side: G is Mechanical, D and taste-heavy T and I blocks are Taste, and anything that changes stated direction is a User Challenge.

cards.title: Entry path (how a new system starts)
cards.default: (default + heuristic) Existing product: audit first. Otherwise brief first, with an optional reference; offer a kit only as a component base (headless library or registry), not as the visual direction.

cards.title: Reference intake: fidelity and the identity firewall
cards.default: (default + heuristic) Default to reinterpretation for inspiration references and replication-with-identity-swap only when the person says "our version of this". Never carry name, logo, copy, photography, illustration or proprietary fonts; offer licensed substitutes and log each substitution [S-L17-022] [S-L17-023].

cards.title: Designer-hook policy (ask, accept, fall back)
cards.default: (default + heuristic) Grouped checklist; fallback order: have it > commission a designer (with the generated brief) > open library with a compatible licence > named tool with its caveat > omit. Never present a generated identity asset as final.

cards.title: Variant generation (how "show me options" works)
cards.default: (default + heuristic) 3 concepts in text, confirm, render on real components with light and dark side by side; remix at block level; lock and shuffle for fine exploration afterwards.

cards.title: Proposal framing (safe choices versus risks)
cards.default: (default + heuristic) Always show the split; default to 2 risks, at least one tied to the memorable thing.

cards.title: Anti-generic guardrails
cards.default: (default + heuristic) Lint with waivers, deterministic first, model critique second; taste rules warn, accessibility rules fail.

cards.title: Pacing (where the model slows down)
cards.default: (default + heuristic) Weight time by fan-out and class; never auto-decide an I block; auto-decide G blocks with visible defaults.

cards.title: Coverage check and completeness scoring
cards.default: (default + heuristic) Per-block status plus a 0-10 score per layer with the gap in plain words; export allowed with a named remainder.

cards.title: What the process records (for harmony and team communication)
cards.default: (default + heuristic) Always write all six records; the packaging of these files is L18's scope.

cards.title: Preview substrate during the process
cards.default: (default + heuristic) Rendered components for every decision; raster only for optional mood boards, labeled as such.

cards.title: Approval gates
cards.default: (default + heuristic) Three gates (block map and scope, direction, assets) plus a final taste-decision review; Quick mode keeps only the direction gate.

cards.title: The per-block detail panel (how the builder teaches while editing)
cards.block: Builder > Guidance > Block detail panel (every G block; component pages extend DC-L08-23)
cards.default: (default + heuristic) Always show what it is, where to use, where not to (with the alternative and a threshold when one exists), a live preview in all modes, its source, and what else changes. Keep it short: NN/g's lean-team guidance favors precise over exhaustive docs [S-L17-113].
